name: High Energy Batteries (India) Ltd
tagline: Defence / aerospace specialty-battery microcap — profitability has recovered but five-year growth is ~nil and no confirmed order-led inflection
business_overview: High Energy Batteries (India) Ltd makes silver-oxide, thermal and reserve batteries for defence and aerospace applications (torpedoes, submarines, missiles, aircraft) plus some industrial/automotive lead-acid batteries. Chennai-based microcap (~Rs 513 Cr).
fundamentals_table: ROCE ~20.4% / ROE ~15.4% — recovered from a prior loss-making quarter
fundamentals_narrative: Since the old 108-stock screen flagged this as AVOID (a quarter where sales fell from ~Rs 29.5 Cr to ~Rs 7.9 Cr and the company slipped to a loss), profitability has recovered — ROCE ~20% and ROE ~15% on the latest data, with positive book value and negligible debt. But five-year sales growth is essentially zero: defence battery orders are lumpy and project-timed, so a single strong quarter is not a trend. No specific new order or contract catalyst has been confirmed this pass.
technical_read: Not independently pulled; stock mid-range within its 52-week band.

Profitability fully recovered — ROCE ~20%, ROE ~15%, near-debt-free, positive book value
Genuine microcap (~Rs 513 Cr) — order-led operating leverage could be large if defence demand steps up

verdict_headline: Profitability restored, but flat multi-year growth and no confirmed order catalyst keep it a watch
verdict_reasoning: Re-check of a legacy-108-screen seed; the old 2026-08-15 AVOID (loss-making quarter, sales collapse) no longer applies — ROCE ~20%, ROE ~15%, near-debt-free now
